text:
alex: heads-up: plan to cordon and reboot rack 12c in eu-west3 this tues 03:00 UTC. rolling across 6 cohorts, ~30m per cohort. intend to drain, reboot, kv cache regen, then uncordon. low traffic window.

sam: what are the main risks? e.g., burst capacity, prefix cache cold starts?

alex: main risks: long tail KV regen on large seq workloads, egress saturations during backfill, and canary pod restarts hitting dedicated pools.

jin: timeline? can we do canary first for 2 nodes and validate model routing fallback?

alex: yes. canary 02:45-03:00 UTC on 2 nodes. if OK, proceed. rollback plan: stop after current cohort, shift traffic to eu-west2 and us-west1 if needed.

maria: cost note: if we backfill onto burst capacity it'll add ~$1.2k/hr for that window. do we have approval?

lia: ops-sre flagged this for SLA customers. we should disable canaries for premium tenants (they stay on pinned capacity) and slide them to reserve pool.

ops-sre: tagging in incident-bot: @ops-sre start maintenance window 7342109876. monitor p99 latency and queued requests.

devops-bot: maintenance scheduled by alex at 2025-06-10T03:00:00Z for rack-12c. notifying oncall.

sam: quick checklist: 1) set prow autoscale cooldown 2) preseed KV cache: run kvseed script 3) confirm route fallback rules

alex: preseed command:
```
./scripts/kvseed --rack rack-12c --threads 8 --mode gradual
kubectl cordon rack-12c-node-{01..06}
kubectl drain rack-12c-node-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
please run in order.

jin: will run kvseed at 02:30 UTC and post perf numbers. if regen > 5min median, abort.

maria: i'll file cost hold and notify finance lead.

lia: customer comms: draft msg ready. cc-ing support.

sam: +1. also add metric alert: increase in request queued > 200 for 3m -> rollback.

alex: thanks. i'll post final go/no-go 02:40 UTC. ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
